criteria.requirement: Give a workable explicit policy: x/exclusive creation for no-overwrite, or a validated temporary result and deliberate atomic replacement when replacement is allowed. A pre-check alone is racy and atomic replacement alone does not mean no-overwrite. Do not promise transactions or invent a Click must_not_exist API.
Use the actual supplied evidence and pinned source, respect authorization, and distinguish observed behavior, existing guarantees and proposals.

comparison: Accept equivalent correct reasoning and implementations; do not match wording or a reference answer.
